$comment: Token-only UI patterns — a project's own visual language with no brand-voice manifest, unlike design-system/manifests/ profiles. The demo renders each as an extra tab alongside the three brand profiles: colors, type, spacing, and a themed component gallery, but no voice/tone/logo/template sections since none of that data exists for these. `default: true` makes an entry the demo's initial tab and the leading example in README's consumption prompt, overriding manifests/index.json's defaultProfileId.

patterns.name: therileys-team
patterns.tagline: A homelab/product UI token set — not a brand-voice profile.
